# FOSS Andhra

> Building open source infrastructure for Andhra Pradesh — campus clubs, Telugu-language AI tools, civic tech, and policy advocacy for digital sovereignty.

## Organization
- Name: FOSS Andhra (Free and Open Source Software Andhra Pradesh)
- Type: Non-Governmental Organisation (NGO)
- Location: Yesj Centre for Excellence, Vijayawada, Andhra Pradesh 520008, India
- Contact: office@fossap.in | +91 94944 63840
- Website: https://fossap.in
- GitHub: https://github.com/fossandhra
- LinkedIn: https://linkedin.com/company/fossandhra
- YouTube: https://youtube.com/@fossandhra
- Twitter/X: https://twitter.com/fossandhra

## Mission
To build Andhra Pradesh's open source layer — empowering students to contribute to global projects, deploying FOSS in schools and government, and developing Telugu-language computing tools that serve 82 million people.

## 2026 Focus Areas
- Open source AI infrastructure: helping AP institutions use and contribute to open models (Llama, Mistral, Whisper) rather than depending on proprietary AI
- Telugu NLP and regional-language computing: closing the gap in Indic-language open source tooling
- India DPI alignment: supporting AP government and institutions adopting DIGIT, ONDC, Beckn, and other open public infrastructure
- Campus contributor pipeline: growing FOSSynC clubs into feeders for GSoC, Outreachy, and global open source projects

## Core Values
- Open Knowledge: knowledge must be freely accessible without paywalls or proprietary lock-in
- Data Privacy: community-owned, auditable systems that protect digital sovereignty
- Public Welfare: technology built for society, not shareholders — aligned with India's DPI ethos
- Offline First: tools that work on low-end Android and 2G, because rural AP cannot wait

## Programs

### FOSStar — Membership Network
700+ students, developers, and institutions across Andhra Pradesh. Tiers for students, professionals, and institutions.
https://fossap.in/programs/fosstar

### FOSServe — Education and Governance Deployment
Replacing proprietary software in AP schools and government offices with auditable, community-owned open source tools.
https://fossap.in/programs/fosserve

### FOSSynC — Campus FOSS Clubs
9+ active chapters at JNTU Kakinada, Andhra University, NIT Tadepalligudem, IIT Tirupati, SVU Tirupati, KL University, VIT-AP, RVR College, and GITAM. Building the next generation of open source contributors.
https://fossap.in/programs/fossync

### FOSStorm — Community Software Projects
Active projects: TeluguNLP (NLP toolkit for Telugu language, 120+ stars), OpenEdu (offline-first LMS), CivicDocs (government document management), FarmConnect (agricultural data platform). All code at github.com/fossandhra.
https://fossap.in/programs/fosstorm

### FOSStart — Open Source Startup Incubation
Seed funding support, mentorship, and licensing guidance for founders building on open source foundations in Andhra Pradesh.
https://fossap.in/programs/fosstart

### FOSSterage — Open Knowledge Repository
Curated datasets, research archives, and learning materials for Telugu-language computing, Indic NLP, and open source AI toolchains.
https://fossap.in/programs/fossterage

### FOSSpeaks — Advocacy and Outreach
Speakers, workshops, and policy advocacy for open source adoption in AP institutions and government. Available for college events and government seminars.
https://fossap.in/programs/fosspeaks

## Community Stats
- 700+ community members
- 9+ campus clubs across Andhra Pradesh
- 50+ events hosted
- 4 active open source projects
- 7 programmes
